item.title: Safari Birthday Banner Printable, Custom Name Banner Kit A-Z, Wild One Party Decor
item.description: Safari birthday banner printable kit: every letter from A to Z, numbers 0 to 9 and jungle animal flags, so you can spell any name or age yourself. A matching Happy Birthday cake topper is included. Download the PDF, print at home on cardstock, cut out the flags and string them up for a wild one, two wild or jungle themed party. Tap to get the instant download on Etsy. Digital file, nothing is shipped.
